paragraphs: Here's the big idea, friend. God wants hearts that match the worship. The LORD says, "What good to Me is your multitude of sacrifices?" (Isaiah 1:11). They were doing all the religious stuff, and He says their hands are covered with blood (Isaiah 1:15). That's like me stamping a gorgeous cookie and the dough underneath is raw. It looks great and it's not the point!

So what does He want? He says, "Stop doing evil!" and "Learn to do right; seek justice and correct the oppressor. Defend the fatherless and plead the case of the widow" (Isaiah 1:16-17). Faith that stays in the building is not what He's asking for. Real faith walks out the door and takes care of people who have no one to stand up for them. I think this one is for all of us, friend, and I'm including myself.

And then comes the part that gets me every time. "Come now, let us reason together," says the LORD. "Though your sins are like scarlet, they will be as white as snow" (Isaiah 1:18). He called out their rebellion straight, and in the same breath He opened the door. If you are willing and obedient, you will eat the best of the land (Isaiah 1:19). Years ago I was sure I was done for in the back of a junk drawer, and I can tell you He is good at making things new.
